title: PriS Privacy Process Pattern record
description: Machine-readable representation of the textual part of a Privacy Process Pattern (Alexandrian format): context, problem, forces, benefits, liabilities, related patterns and implementation techniques grouped by category. Formalises the template in Listing 2 of the manuscript (adapted from Diamantopoulou et al., 2017). The BPMN process fragment of a pattern is kept separately (patterns/bpmn/).

Name.description: Privacy property realised by the pattern.

Related patterns.description: Patterns that this pattern invokes, presupposes or complements. Should not include the pattern itself (checked by tools/validate.py).

Implementation techniques.description: Available technical alternatives, grouped by category.

privacyProperty.description: Kept identical to the list in pris-privacy-requirement.schema.json (checked by tests/run_tests.py).
